Purpose: A reported symptom traced through code and history into evidence-tiered claims.

<!-- aiscr:ecosystem-only -->
Delegate: `aiscr-investigate`.
Contract: `investigation`.
Cost tier: `standard`.
Maintained by `aiscr-plan-issue`.
<!-- aiscr:ecosystem-end -->

Read the surfaces the report names and cite them as path and line.
Search the history of those surfaces for the change that introduced the behaviour, and search existing reports for the verbatim error text so a duplicate is found rather than created.
Reproduce through entry points the repository already defines, and record what the attempt actually did.
Separate what was observed from why it happens: the observation is a claim, the cause is a hypothesis until evidence carries it.

Exclusions: Proposing the fix, drafting the issue text, and any claim the assigned material cannot support.
